metric_semantics.cost_usd: offline estimated USD cost from aggregate token estimates
metric_semantics.duration_seconds: span between the minimum and maximum validated event timestamps
metric_semantics.lint_violations: count of deterministic findings over minimized telemetry
metric_semantics.redundant_read_ratio: repeated anonymous resource reads after the first divided by all anonymous resource reads
metric_semantics.session_status: recorded process termination only; not task completion or correctness
